Sumanth Namburi

Artist. Author. Explorer of Perspective.

Perspective changes everything.

Discover the book Meet the artist
from here, a ninefrom the water, a six

Look again

One mark. Two honest readings.

Stand on one side of a figure and it reads as a nine. Walk around it, and the same figure reads as a six. Scroll, and walk around it.

One person, several rooms.

Sumanth Namburi draws, writes, teaches and serves. He is the author of The Other Side Of Nine, an artist since his student years, Director of NSV EDUSPACE and a Rotarian from Hindupur.

Each part of his work has its own page. Start wherever you like.
